text: יהוה, who does sojourn in Your Tent? Who does dwell in Your set-apart mountain?
He who walks blamelessly, And does righteousness, And speaks the truth in his heart.
He has not slandered with his tongue, He has not done evil to his neighbour, Nor lifted up a reproach against his friend;
In whose eyes a reprobate one is despised, But he esteems those who fear יהוה; He who swears to his own hurt and does not change;
He has not put out his silver at interest, And has not taken a bribe against the innocent. He who does these is never moved.
